title: research-graph-execute Configuration
description: ADR-045 execute_subqueries: materialise sub-queries from RouteDecision intent + fan-out across Tier 0+1 retrieval + dedup + rank + budget. Emits ExecutionOutput for R3.

loops_bucket.description: NATS KV bucket holding research-pipeline loops and trigger/completion keys

max_parallelism.description: Concurrent sub-query execution cap. Keeps fan-out from saturating gateways. 0 means default (8)

max_results_per_subquery.description: Per-sub-query result count cap before ranking + budget enforcement. Prevents a runaway sub-query from dominating evidence. 0 means default (50)

ports.description: Port configuration. execute_subqueries requires one nats input subscribing to component.execute_subqueries.>
